text: From the Quantum ESPRESSO test, round two (run dft/20261117-3 collect-1; meta_agent/failures.jsonl dft-8, in meta's paths): the Designer's S6 in its environment (meta_agent/src/validate/gate.py) left its isolated copy of the bundle in the system's temporary folder, 5.4 GB each time, while validation_report.json says the copy was removed; shutil.rmtree with ignore_errors hides why. Asked: the cause, and whether the report may say 'removed' without checking it. dft-7's meta side (the template's gate for a data fetch, the Designer carrying a material's files) waits on the design role's answer.
